newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to tender for 26,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to tender for 26,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat.

text.p: The Taiwan Flour Mills Association will tender on Thursday for a 26,000-tonne shipment of U.S. wheat, traders said on Monday.
The tender specifies that the shipment include Dark Northern Spring (DNS), Hard Red Winter (HRW) and White Wheat (WW), all slated for delivery from the Pacific Northwest, traders said.

A March 20 government ban on pork exports sparked by an outbreak of hog foot and mouth disease has slashed demand for imports of feed corn and soybeans, but the impact on Taiwan's wheat demand has been limited, traders said.
"Wheat is only a small part of feed consumption so imports should not be affected much," a wheat buyer said.
